# Caduceus

> Caduceus is a free, open-source, local-first command centre for macOS. It provides a floating staff shortcut bar, a command palette (apps, maths, clipboard history, and 154 built-in features covering sticky notes, meeting recording and transcription, unit and currency conversion, colour picking, disk cleanup and app uninstall, folder tidying, citations, process management, window management, developer tools, on-device screen OCR, system control, files, network and sound — each with its own purpose-built page), optional voice dictation, and AI chat plus computer-use when you configure a backend. Offline features work without an account or API key.

Important notes:

- Commonly searched for as an open-source alternative to Raycast, Alfred, Spotlight, Maccy and Amphetamine; it covers the launcher, clipboard-history, window-management and keep-awake ground those tools occupy, without an account or a subscription.
- Built with Tauri, Rust and React; one ~10 MB universal binary.
- Fully open source (GPL-3.0-or-later; MIT through v2.3.1) and fully customizable — hotkeys, prefixes, backends, and optional extensions.
- No monetization, no data collection, no telemetry, and no tracking. Private and secure by default; as local as you want (offline core workflow, optional local or cloud AI only if you configure it). The market and sports widgets are the one exception, and only once you add one: they fetch public quotes and scores from CoinGecko, Yahoo Finance and ESPN. No account, no key, and nothing about you goes with the request — but those hosts do see your IP, so a widget you have not added fetches nothing at all.
- macOS 11 (Big Sur) or later; universal binary (Apple Silicon and Intel).
- Menu bar app only — no Dock icon. Notarized signing is not in place yet; the installer clears the quarantine attribute after download.
- AI is optional: `/` routes to your configured chat backend; `/c` starts computer-use (Hermes is the supported path for screen control). Caduceus does not ship its own mouse or screen driver.
- Extensions are single `.js` files with a `@caduceus` header comment; they install by drag-and-drop and run in a Web Worker sandbox with a permission-checked `ctx` API. No folders, no `caduceus.json` manifest.

## Website

- [Overview](https://caduceus.vivaanshahani.com/): Product summary, install one-liner, and screenshots.
- [All features](https://caduceus.vivaanshahani.com/features): Checklist of built-in behaviour (staff, palette, clipboard, voice, capture, AI, settings).
- [Docs](https://caduceus.vivaanshahani.com/docs): Architecture and implementation notes for contributors (Tauri, Rust modules, events, shortcuts); user guide includes **Write your own extension**.
- [Configure AI](https://caduceus.vivaanshahani.com/configure-ai): Hermes, Ollama, OpenAI-compatible CLIs, and cloud API setup for `/` and `/c`.

## Source and install

- [README](https://github.com/GeoWizard4645/caduceus/blob/main/README.md): Install from release or source, feature overview, build instructions.
- [Releases](https://github.com/GeoWizard4645/caduceus/releases): Latest universal `.dmg` attached to each GitHub release.
- [install.sh](https://vivaanshahani.com/caduceus/install.sh): Curl-to-bash installer (release DMG or `--from-source`).
- [Homebrew tap](https://github.com/GeoWizard4645/homebrew-caduceus): `brew install --cask geowizard4645/caduceus/caduceus`. Same universal DMG; the cask clears the quarantine flag in a postflight block, which `--no-quarantine` skips.

## Optional

- [Extension system](https://github.com/GeoWizard4645/caduceus/blob/main/EXTENSIONS.md): The one-file format, the Web Worker sandbox, the permission set, and the `ctx` API.
- [GitHub issues](https://github.com/GeoWizard4645/caduceus/issues): Bugs and feature requests.
- [Release process](https://github.com/GeoWizard4645/caduceus/blob/main/RELEASE.md): How maintainers cut and publish macOS builds.
- Contact: caduceus@vivaanshahani.com
